title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Where: BT Customer Contact Centre, Gosforth Park Way, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE12 8 ET

Full time: Permanent

Salary: £26,116 rising to £26.738 after 8 months of being here, plus incentives and bonuses

Start date: January 2027

Shifts: 12 hour shifts on a two week rotation.

Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 08:30-21:00 08:45-21:00 OFF OFF OFF 08:00-20:00 08:00-20:00 OFF OFF 08:45-21:00 08:45-21:00 08:45-21:00 OFF OFF

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team's in Newcastle and North Tyneside are full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Internal Sales Executive
company: Effective Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Internal Sales Executive - Electrical Wholesale
Electrical Wholesale Sales Advisor / Internal Sales Executive. A Sunderland based electrical wholesaler have an opportunity for an Internal Sales Executive / Telesales Executive to join the team in both an office-based position and a customer facing trade counter role.
The Electrical Wholesale Sales Advisor / Internal Sales Executive will either make outbound B2 B telesales calls contacting businesses who would use their products whilst managing accounts and establishing long lasting relationships with existing customers and would also be down on the trade floor serving customers and liaising with warehouse workers. The appropriate candidate would be someone who is willing to help in all areas.
The Internal Sales Executive / Telesales Executive will need:
- Outbound telesales experience
- Experience of selling to suitable decision makers
- Excellent communication skills
- Experience working for an Electrical Wholesaler, merchant or something similar
- Trade Counter experience desirable
- Driving Licence preferred but not essential

The Internal Sales Executive / Telesales Executive salary is 32226k depending on experience plus commission, profit share and other bonuses.
Hours of work are 7:30-17:00 Monday to Friday, 1 in 5 Saturday mornings paid as overtime
Proactive People is an employment agency

title: Temporary School Administrator - Sunderland - Part - Time
description:
Temporary School Administrator - Sunderland - Part - Time

Are you an organised and proactive administrator looking to make a positive impact within the education sector? Our client is seeking a Temporary Ongoing School Administrator to join their busy and welcoming team in Sunderland

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operations of a busy school environment while providing a professional and friendly service to students, parents, staff, and visitors.

Position Details:

Job Title: Part - Time School Administrator

Start Date: ASAP

Pay Rate: 13- 14 per hour, depending on experience

Contract Type: Temporary Ongoing

Location: Sunderland. Free onsite parking

Working Pattern: Part - Time, 8 hours per week. Each Thursday and Friday, 8:30am - 12:30pm.

A DBS check and stringent compliance checks will be completed prior to the role commencing. Candidates with a current DBS registered on the Update Service are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

As the School Administrator, you will be the first point of contact for visitors, staff, and students. Working in a busy and fast-paced environment, you will provide essential administrative support to help ensure the smooth running of the school.

Your responsibilities will include:

Front of House: Greeting parents, staff, and visitors in a professional and welcoming manner.

Telephone Management: Handling incoming calls, responding to enquiries, and directing calls to the appropriate departments.

Administrative Support: Providing vital administrative assistance across various departments within the school and support with the completion of registers.

Record Maintenance: Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records using internal systems and databases.

Reception Duties: Managing reception duties and ensuring a positive experience for all visitors.

What We're Looking For:

Previous administration experience, ideally within a school or educational setting.

Previous experience working with SIMS and/or Arbor is desirable.

Excellent organisational and time management skills.

Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

A professional, flexible, and positive approach to work.

The ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Why Join Us?
- Weekly Pay: Enjoy weekly pay throughout your temporary contract.
- Annual Leave: Accrue 28 days of annual leave, inclusive of bank holidays.
- Pension Scheme: Benefit from a pension scheme with employer contributions.
- Additional Perks: Access to eye-care vouchers and high-street discount schemes.
- Professional Development: Opportunities for training and professional growth.
- Supportive Environment: Work in a collaborative and friendly atmosphere

If you are eager to play a key role in supporting a busy school environment and have the skills and experience, we're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for this opportunity!

Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: GP Receptionist/Administrator
description: You will be a welcoming first point of contact for patients and a valued member of our friendly and supportive practice team. We are looking for someone reliable, organised and confident communicating with people face to face. Previous GP reception experience is an advantage, but not essential. We also welcome applicants with strong customer service experience who enjoy helping people, can manage a variety of tasks and are quick to learn new online systems. Good IT skills, excellent communication and a friendly, professional approach are essential. The role is 37.5 hours per week, working varied shifts between 08:00 and 18:00, Monday to Friday, excluding bank holidays. Pay is dependant on experience. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if sufficient applications are received. Early applications are encouraged. Primary Key Responsibilities Front Desk & Patient Interaction Welcome patients and visitors, providing a friendly and professional service. Answer telephone calls, manage queries, and direct patients appropriately. Book, amend, and cancel patient appointments efficiently. Administrative Duties Process patient registrations, deductions, and update records as required. Handle prescription requests, ensuring accuracy and liaising with clinicians when necessary. Scan, file, and organise correspondence, including medical reports and clinical letters. Referrals management Supporting Clinical Staff Assist with medical documentation requests from patients, insurance companies, and other entities. Maintain confidentiality and uphold data protection regulations in all tasks. General Reception & Office Management Maintain a clean and organised reception area. Monitor stock levels of stationery and office supplies. Support the practice team with administrative tasks as required. The post holder will be expected to provide general administration duties, which may include but is not limited to; To assist in keeping patient records accurate and up to date by scanning and attaching paper documents in to electronic records. Filing scanned documents into patient electronic notes (EMIS) Electronically filing test results and other documents/patient information Perform computer searches and data collection to support practice enhanced services and ensure clinical safety. Keeping all records including staff trainings up to date for CQC purposes. Monitoring telephone call queue daily. To liaise with the manager to make sure all tasks are completed at the end of day. Helping patients by dealing with requests or questions in a polite, professional and efficient manner. Telephoning patients to inform them about prescriptions, to move/book or rebook appointments, or gather personal data in a sensitive manner, such as smoking status, when asked to do so. Printing and distributing repeat prescriptions. Registering patients, ensuring that information is checked and documented accurately. General administration involving patient records, audits etc. as required. Prepare medical reports and other requests for information are processed accurately and in a timely manner, ensuring practice protocols regarding information governance and confidentiality are adhered to. Record-keeping, distribution of documents, filing are all undertaken accurately and efficiently. Taking responsibility for the scheduling and co-ordination of meetings. Management of the generic email inbox. You should have previous administrative experience, preferably familiar with EMIS Web GP system. Good written and verbal communication skills are essential together with highly effective organisational and planning skills.

title: Business Support Administrator

At North East and North Cumbria Integrated Care Board, we are committed to providing high-quality care and support to our community. Please note that applications are only being accepted from current staff members of North East and North Cumbria Integrated Care Board and North of England Commissioning Support (NECS). We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the closing date once the required number of suitable applications has been received.
